SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE
Ransomware crew exploits CVE-2024-4577 to deploy LockBit against unpatched PHP servers

Researchers observed a campaign in which attackers exploited a public-facing
PHP-CGI argument injection flaw (CVE-2024-4577) to gain initial access to
Windows web servers. Following compromise, the operators executed encoded
PowerShell commands to download a second-stage payload from
hxxp://update-service[.]xyz/stage2.ps1 and established persistence through
registry Run keys.

Before encryption, the intrusion set deleted volume shadow copies using
vssadmin and staged data for exfiltration to 45[.]61[.]136[.]39 over an
encrypted channel. The final LockBit payload (SHA-256:
e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855) encrypted
files across mapped drives. Cobalt Strike beacons were recovered from two
hosts, and operators contacted victims from ops@lockbit-support[.]top.
